"""Pending authority: four actual site-prompt calls on existing frozen controls."""
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path[:0] = [str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent), str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent)]

from distill.config import DistillConfig
from distill.eval.research_desk_cases import CASES
from distill.ingestors.sites.records import SitePage
from distill.library.paths import atomic_write_text
from distill.pipeline.analysis import site
from distill.prompts.registry import PROMPT_IDS
from third_trial_support import ROOT, ThirdTrial


def main():
    trial = ThirdTrial()
    site.llm_call = trial.bounded_call
    trial.receipt['phase1_prompt_id'] = PROMPT_IDS['analysis.site_page']
    providers = ('ollama', 'openrouter') if trial.cloud_allowed else ('ollama',)
    config = DistillConfig(distill_output_dir=ROOT / 'library')
    for case_id in ('faros-headline-body', 'synthetic-probability'):
        case = CASES[case_id]
        source = case.sources[0]
        text = '\n\n'.join(f'{anchor.anchor_id} [{anchor.role}; {"authored context" if anchor.authored else "frozen page excerpt"}]: {anchor.text}' for anchor in source.anchors)
        atomic_write_text(ROOT / 'sources' / f'{case_id}.txt', text)
        page = SitePage(url=source.locator if source.locator.startswith('https://') else 'https://example.invalid/synthetic-trial',
                        title=source.title, site_name='Frozen public source' if case_id.startswith('faros') else 'Synthetic control',
                        page_type='article', text=text)
        for provider in providers:
            label = f'phase1-{case_id}-{provider}'
            if any(row.get('case_label') == label for row in trial.receipt['calls']):
                continue
            start = len(trial.receipt['calls'])
            try:
                router = trial.config_for(provider)
                result = site.analyze_site_page(page, config, tracker=trial.tracker, router_config=router)
                atomic_write_text(ROOT / 'outputs' / f'{label}.md', result)
                print(label, 'completed')
            except Exception as exc:
                print(label, type(exc).__name__)
            finally:
                for row in trial.receipt['calls'][start:]:
                    row['case_label'] = label
                trial.save()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
